scope: all 35 deduplicated retained InfoQ documents returned by experiments.ershi_cohort_statistics.load_articles(), restricted to pre/post and not known_translation, including all zero-connector documents
selection_expression: source == 'infoq' and cohort in ('pre', 'post') and not known_translation
current_methodological_role: Translation is a provenance stratum. The legacy original-only temporal comparison is a sensitivity/control view; translated documents remain research and product-diagnostic material.
legacy_status_note: The status field preserves the requested legacy exclusion nomenclature for transparent recalculation. current_provenance_status records the current translation/provenance finding; no row is globally excluded from research.
methods: Read the full bodies computationally for targeted provenance markers, then inspect all marker contexts and article openings or endings as relevant. This is not full semantic verification of every source relationship.
Inspect author, translator, and recorded translation-evidence fields for all 35 retained documents.

Inspect the retained article scope and embedded author/translator fields of 18 available full local HTML captures (16 staged captures and 2 later pilot recaptures), excluding unrelated recommended articles from provenance reasoning.
Validate each evidence quotation and its zero-based end-exclusive Unicode offsets against the exact UTF-8-decoded source file, preserving CRLF where present.
Verify retained corpus-body hashes separately from monthly-file serialization hashes; never modify bodies, metadata, frozen semantic reviews, or historical outcomes.
marker_pattern: 译|譯|翻訳|[编編][纂輯]|整理|改编|改編|摘编|摘編|原作|原文|授权|授權|转载|轉載|來源|来源|translated|translation|compiled|adapted\s+from
decision_rule: A disclosure that the article or its substantial interview/source content was translated or compiled from foreign content is decisive. A verified foreign-language source/author relationship with an original link can also be decisive, but a romanized name, biography alone, English URL slug, foreign citation, foreign topic, Chinese republication, or translationese alone is insufficient.
limitations: Absence of a located disclosure is not evidence of original composition, high quality, or corpus admission.
This audit is bounded to the 35 previously retained local InfoQ documents; it does not establish provenance prevalence for InfoQ, other sources, or the full temporal corpus.
No external originals, author profiles, or network resources were fetched. Seventeen documents have no located full HTML capture in the searched local data tree.
Image-only disclosures were not OCR-reviewed. Uncaptured, omitted, or differently worded provenance statements can remain undetected.
The two Snowflake external-original-link cases remain unresolved because local evidence does not establish source language or adaptation; names and English URL slugs are not substitutes.

For translated media, an observed reading defect can be inherited from the source, introduced during translation, or affected by editing/capture. This audit does not allocate those causes without paired source evidence.
Translated interviews with local introductions remain whole-document translated provenance strata. Their source bodies and diagnostic semantic reviews are retained.
No original/high-quality labels, authorship labels, training labels, admission decisions, or editing-efficacy claims are produced.
